string.text:
There's not much I can tell you unless you're looking for work. I know a guy. He's rich in all senses of the word - silly and privileged in equal measure. He's out there, treating the Zone like a safari right now. He doesn't care for artefacts. All he wants to do is collect old guns... and shoot pigs with them. He even wants to find a scoped TOZ-34 "Bizon" that has "seen some genuine Zone action," as a souvenir! And what he wants to pay is absolutely through the roof!
 
The problem is, the last guy I met who knew where to find a TOZ-34 "Bizon" is Hunter, and he died years ago. None of the big-time traders below the Barrier seem interested in finding one, either - they don't seem to think it's worth their time.
 
But if you find one, bring me the TOZ-34 "Bizon" along with 20 rounds of 12x70 buckshot, and you'll be paid several times what it'd fetch you elsewhere.
